# Takmeel Square

> Takmeel Square is the largest commercial hub of South Punjab, a 1.2 million sq ft development on the Main Boulevard of DHA Bahawalpur, Punjab, Pakistan. It combines commercial units, Takmeel Bazaar (260 shops), Takmeel Homes luxury villas and the 4-acre Glow Park.

## Key facts
- Location: Takmeel Square, Main Boulevard, DHA Bahawalpur, Punjab, Pakistan (29.3264° N, 71.6792° E)
- Distance: 3.6 KM from Bahawalpur Airport, 4.9 KM from Bahawalpur Cantt
- Covered area: 1.2 million sq ft
- Commercial units: 68 × 4 Marla and 19 × 6 Marla, 7 floors each (A Block faces Main Boulevard, B Block faces Glow Park)
- Takmeel Bazaar: 7 floors, 260 shops, New Rangeela Bazaar (cloth), New Sarafa Bazaar (gold & jewellery), New Tech Bazaar (mobile & technology), rooftop restaurants
- Takmeel Homes: 1 Kanal villas (Sector A), 8 & 10 Marla homes (Sector C), DHA Bahawalpur
- Glow Park: 4-acre illuminated park with food court and seating for 600
- Parking: 1,100 spaces including underground parking; shuttle service
- Facilities: CCTV, prayer area, ablution, washrooms, active piazzas, landscaped walkways; Al-Fatah
- Leadership: Capt (R) Dr. Kamran Fazal (CEO), Dr. Qaisra Fazal, Humaira Fazal, Capt Saera Fazal (Directors)

## Around Takmeel Square
- Bahawalpur Airport: 3.6 KM
- Bahawalpur Cantt: 4.9 KM
- DHA Bahawalpur Main Gate and Southern Bypass: beside Takmeel Square
- DHA Club & Allied Facilities: next to Takmeel Square
- Also nearby: DHA Office, Villa Community, CMH Institute of Medical Sciences, Cholistan University of Veterinary & Animal Sciences, Yazman Road
